capex_guidance.headline: ~$175B FY2027 capex, reaffirmed (accounting-driven, not a cut)
capex_guidance.detail: FY2027 capex guided to ~$175B (incl. finance leases), down from ~$190B discussed in April. CFO Amy Hood said underlying spending plans are unchanged — the drop reflects extending data center useful life to 25 years, shifting leases from finance to operating. Q1 FY27 guided over $50B.

capex_guidance.headline: $195-205B FY2026 capex, raised from $180-190B
capex_guidance.detail: On the Q2 2026 call, CFO Anat Ashkenazi raised full-year 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B from the prior $180-190B range given after Q1 2026, citing accelerated delivery of AI/data center capacity to meet demand.
